ex.en: My suitcase is overweight, so I have to pay an extra fee.
ex.zh: 我的行李箱超重了，所以得付額外的費用。

ex.en: Overweight bags must be repacked before check-in.
ex.zh: 超重的行李必須在報到前重新整理。

ex.en: Sixty-nine percent of adult Americans are either overweight or obese.

The flight was overbooked, so some passengers had to take a later one.
ex.zh: 這班飛機超賣了，所以有些乘客只好改搭晚一點的班機。

ex.en: Airlines sometimes offer vouchers when a flight is overbooked.
ex.zh: 航班超賣時，航空公司有時會提供抵用券。

ex.en: Use the overpass to cross the highway.
There's a bus stop under the overpass.
If you overstay your visa, you may be fined.
ex.zh: 如果簽證逾期停留，你可能會被罰款。

ex.en: He was deported for overstaying his visa.
ex.zh: 他因為簽證逾期停留而被驅逐出境。

ex.en: She oversees a team of twenty people.
ex.zh: 她督導一個二十人的團隊。

ex.en: An engineer will oversee the construction.
ex.zh: 會有一位工程師監督施工。

ex.en: The project had a cost overrun of 20%.
We need to avoid any more overruns.

overrun.zh: 超過（時間、預算）；侵占、蔓延

ex.en: The meeting overran by half an hour.
The garden was overrun with weeds.

ex.zh: 家豪說他今天不來了，臨時要加班。
